purpose: Attack G8, G9 and G11 in one controlled cross-process experiment by binding the durable Genesis boot controller to SWARM lease fencing and the DemiHead NOHAND Git-mediated handoff witness.
mandatory_sequence: worker-A executes one bounded controller segment
fence is asserted immediately before durable checkpoint delegate
worker-A emits exact checkpoint-bound NOHAND request and durable handoff receipt
worker-A exits via deliberate ungraceful process death
worker-B starts as a fresh interpreter with durable filesystem inputs only
worker-B acquires a new fencing token only after worker-A lease expiry
worker-B reproduces the exact prior checkpoint receipt from Hippocampus
worker-B resumes instead of restarting the objective
fence is asserted immediately before worker-B durable checkpoint delegate
worker-B reaches bounded WAIT and commits one unique completion receipt
identical duplicate completion becomes idempotent replay
NOHAND outcome is settled and predictor state advances without raw context persistence
reconstructed stale worker-A token is rejected before checkpoint delegate
final completion row count remains exactly one
